observations.what: Free sign-up is a two-page form: email/password/name, then industry, company size, seat count, role, company name and a required phone number, with no option to skip.
The second page reveals new required fields (seats, company name, phone) one at a time as earlier ones are filled, so the layout keeps shifting under the cursor.
After every field was filled, including a valid US phone number, Continue showed the red toast 'We're sorry, we can't create an account for you right now', and a second submit gave the same result.

In the first session (9ecd54f9942348d48ad14064f531aff7) I typed the company name into the phone field because the layout had shifted. That session then timed out while I waited about 10 minutes for the shared SMS number.
